title: Judge verdict (LLM output contract)
description: Strict-JSON verdict returned by the LLM for one candidate. Enums are enforced by the providers' structured-output modes; the confidence range and the 400-character reasoning cap are validated client-side in judge_core.validate_verdict().

evidence_features.description: Field names (or dotted paths) from the candidate context blob. Enforced softly - used for UI highlights, never for control flow.

reasoning.description: One paragraph, no newlines, at most 400 characters.

recommended_action.description: A suggestion for the analyst. Never wired to any enforcement.
